info.name: Book Library API
info.description:
Full collection for the Book Library API (Auth, Categories, Books, Members, Loans). Run order top-to-bottom within each folder: Auth > Categories > Books > Members > Loans. The Cleanup folder is separate on purpose - see its description.

RBAC: write endpoints (create/update/delete) now require role ADMIN. Register always creates role USER, so promote 'john' to ADMIN via SQL after registering (see the Auth folder description) before running Categories/Books/Members/Loans. See the RBAC check folder for a demonstration of a USER getting 403.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Register/login/refresh are public. Login saves the access token into {{token}} (used automatically as Bearer auth below) and the refresh token into {{refreshToken}}.

IMPORTANT (RBAC): Register always creates the new user with role USER - there is no public way to create an ADMIN, on purpose. Every write endpoint below (Create/Update/Delete on Categories, Books, Members, and Loans) now requires ADMIN. After running Register for 'john', promote it manually in the database before running the rest of this collection:
  UPDATE users SET role = 'ADMIN' WHERE username = 'john';
then Login again so the new token/authorities are picked up.

IMPORTANT (lockout): 5 wrong passwords in a row locks the account for 15 minutes (423 Locked). See the 'Login lockout check' folder below for a demo - don't run it against 'john' unless you're ready to wait out the lock.

request.description: Create a new login user (always role USER). Not the same as a Member (library patron) - this is a login credential. Promote to ADMIN manually via SQL if you need this user to pass the write endpoints below.
Authenticate and get back an access token + refresh token. Auto-saves both for the rest of this collection.
Sanity check that bad credentials are rejected.
Exchanges {{refreshToken}} for a fresh {{token}}, without needing to log in again.
Sanity check that a bogus refresh token is rejected.
Revokes the current user's refresh token. Requires a valid access token (Bearer {{token}}) - run Login again afterwards to get a new session.

item.name: Categories
item.description: Full CRUD for book categories. Run Create first - it saves {{categoryId}}, reused by Books below.

request.description: Saves the new category's id into {{categoryId}}.
Paginated list.

item.name: Books
item.description: Full CRUD + search/filter for books. Create Book needs {{categoryId}} (run Categories > Create Category first).

request.description: Saves the new book's id into {{bookId}}.
Matches keyword against title or author.

item.name: Members
item.description: Full CRUD + search for library members. Create Member saves {{memberId}}, reused by Loans below.

request.description: Saves the new member's id into {{memberId}}.

item.name: Loans
item.description: Borrow/return flow. Needs {{bookId}} and {{memberId}} (run Books and Members Create requests first). Return Book is last so the other GET requests still see status BORROWED.

request.description: Saves the new loan's id into {{loanId}}. Fails 400 if the book is out of stock.
Path value must be BORROWED or RETURNED.
Marks the loan RETURNED and increments the book's stock back.

item.name: Security check
item.description: Confirms protected endpoints actually reject requests with no token.

item.name: RBAC check
item.description: Registers a second, plain USER account and proves it gets 403 on ADMIN-only write endpoints, while GET (read) still works. Does not touch {{token}} - the admin session from the Auth folder is untouched after this runs.

request.description: A second account, left as the default role USER (never promoted to ADMIN).
Saves this USER's token separately into {{userToken}}, so it doesn't overwrite the admin {{token}}.
Read-only endpoints stay open to any authenticated user, not just ADMIN.
A plain USER must be rejected by @PreAuthorize(hasRole('ADMIN')) on this write endpoint.

item.name: Login lockout check
item.description: 5 wrong passwords in a row locks the account for 15 minutes (423 Locked), even with the correct password afterwards. Uses its own throwaway account so it never touches 'john' or {{token}}. Run this folder top-to-bottom.

request.description: A throwaway account just for this lockout demo.
The 5th wrong attempt in a row locks the account.

item.name: Login With Correct Password While Locked (expect 423)

request.description: Even the RIGHT password is rejected while locked - the lock is checked before the password.

item.name: Cleanup (optional - run manually, last)
item.description: Destructive requests. Do NOT run these as part of a full top-to-bottom collection run - other folders above depend on the Category/Book/Member created earlier still existing. Run only when you're done testing, in this order (Book before Category, since Book has a required FK to Category).
